scope: Pier deck and supports, historic carousel building and Ferris-wheel silhouette; no ride simulation or surrounding city blocks.
notes: The exact cleared local 2009 Jelson25 aerial and its native Looff crop already show the surviving swept concave grey roof, low polygonal cupola, three octagonal corner towers, repeated lower arches and paired upper windows. The previous post-2021-roof blocker incorrectly treated a photograph date as an alteration date; no roof change in 2021 is established or needed to explain this geometry. The independently read Santa Monica Conservancy architectural description corroborates the surviving three towers, pointed upper windows, cupola and removal of original ornament; its photographs are not used. Existing 2023 Idealites and 2024 Alexis Doine CC0 originals corroborate the white open Pacific Wheel, red/yellow gondolas, yellow coaster, pier piles, rails, broad park platform, narrow municipal neck and yellow-roof head/harbor office. The cleared local head original supports the already built 57 stepped lamp columns and hooked goosenecks. All 57 existing current portable/shared/version2 context frames inspected, including Looff front/roof and all four runtime levels. Full fixed pier, supports, carousel building, wheel/coaster and head scope retained. Hidden elevations, exact roof curvature, paint, window subdivisions, fine ornament, park kiosks and pile/ride chainages remain bounded medium-fi interpretations using the native mapped envelope. No survey, engineering or exact present restoration claim. Native map, unmodified terrain, placement, source/runtime/LOD bytes and rendered images remain unchanged; no new model construction or capture is claimed.

factualText.use: Architectural facts only; no website photographs used.
factualText.observations: The present building retains three octagonal corner towers with pointed upper windows and a shuttered cupola. Original smaller towers, crenellations and onion dome were removed; the preservation account describes major restoration in the 1980s. It does not date the stripped roof to 2021.
